# h18_infrastructure_call

Report issues: M3, W10, R1.

**Source.** Hand-made SimOxide corpus model (`corpus/h18_infrastructure_call`, generated by refsim's `HandMade.java`). Licence: EPL-2.0 (SimOxide repository). `run.json` and `FEATURES.txt` are SimOxide metadata (`run.json` holds SimuLizar stop conditions; Slingshot uses the simulation time below).

## Model

An InternalAction with an InfrastructureCall (2 calls) to a middleware component via an AssemblyInfrastructureConnector; assembly-operation response-time monitors.

## Run with stock Slingshot

Import the folder into an Eclipse workspace with the Slingshot nightly. Create a *Slingshot Simulation* run configuration:

- Allocation Model: `h18_infrastructure_call.allocation`
- Usage Model: `h18_infrastructure_call.usagemodel`
- Monitor Repository: `h18_infrastructure_call.monitorrepository`
- Simulation tab: maximum simulation time **13 s**; EDP2, an in-memory repository.

The other model files are loaded through the references. Set the console log level to INFO to see the dispatched events and the handler errors (`An error occurred: …`).

The model draws random numbers. Stock Slingshot cannot be seeded, so times and values vary between runs; the effect described below does not depend on them.

## What to look for

- Two errors: `IllegalArgumentException: Cannot determine Signature of SEFFInterpretationContext` in `AssemblyOperationCompoundKey.of` (`AssemblyOperationCompoundKey.java:64`), from `onOperationCallStarted` (`OperationCallActionResponseTimeMonitoringBehavior.java:119`) and `onOperationCallStopped` (`:138`).
- Both handlers are disposed: no assembly-operation response time after the first infrastructure call.
- The infrastructure call's input variable usages are not evaluated for the callee.

## Expected

Infrastructure calls are simulated with their inputs (SimuLizar evaluates them per call); monitors keep working.

## Observed (reference runner)

`observed/` holds the outputs of the SimOxide reference runner, deterministic mode, `-seed 17 -simTime 13` (appendix of `../../REPORT.md`): `errors.txt`, `measurements.csv`, `projection-m.jsonl`, `summary.json`.
`errors.txt` lists the handler exceptions (`exception: message | first Slingshot frame`), one per disposed handler; `measurements.csv` the EDP2 rows (`measuring_point,metric,time,value`); `projection*.jsonl` the dispatched model-level events (users, calls, jobs, measurements, SPD events; `projection-m.jsonl` without passed elements and jobs).

Headless (optional, from `reference/slingshot/`):

```sh
./run.sh --stock -model upstream-report/reproductions/h18_infrastructure_call -out /tmp/h18_infrastructure_call -simTime 13 -seed 1
./run.sh         -model upstream-report/reproductions/h18_infrastructure_call -out /tmp/h18_infrastructure_call-det -simTime 13 -seed 17   # deterministic
```
